title: Conditional-Gibbs block morphism candidate for PAH-001 refinement
proposed_by: TECT research programme under operator directive

parent.composition_rule: This is a separately versioned successor morphism contract. It supplements, but does not edit or supersede, PAH-001 or PAH-OMC-001. Any theorem is about the explicitly composed candidate and is not retroactive evidence for either parent.

exact_scope.coarse_carrier: A finite connected oriented bounded-degree relational two-cell complex G=(V,E,P) with disjoint nonempty anchors O and C.
exact_scope.fine_carrier: A finite connected oriented bounded-degree relational two-cell complex G'=(V',E',P') with anchor-preserving cell map p:G'->G and at least one fine-only vertex z in V' whose coordinate is integrated out by p_Omega. No embedding coordinates, metric, or physical volume is introduced.
exact_scope.regulator: rho and rho' use the PAH-001 tuple rho=(G,O,C,K,M_s,M_psi,R_max,epsilon,a,beta,nu,theta,Q) with the transport table below.
exact_scope.configuration: Omega_(rho,Q) and Omega_(rho',Q) are the finite fixed-Q state spaces obtained from the unchanged PAH-001 functional and the PAH-OMC-001 integer-coordinate completion.
exact_scope.groups: The finite Z_K gauge groups and anchor-preserving automorphism groups already declared by PAH-001 and PAH-OMC-001; p must be equivariant for a specified subgroup homomorphism.
exact_scope.measure: Counting measure followed by the exact finite PAH Gibbs weights pi_(rho,Q) and pi_(rho',Q).
exact_scope.limits: No cutoff, lattice, volume, phase, aperture, beta, observation-time, continuum, or physical limit is taken in this candidate contract.

parameter_transport.K: K'=K and the gauge map is the declared surjection on vertex labels.
parameter_transport.Q: Q'=Q; hidden matter occupation is part of the same fixed-Q sector.
parameter_transport.M_s: M_s'=M_s; no half-grid or interpolated aperture values are inserted.
parameter_transport.a: a'=a; the refinement label is not identified with a physical length.
parameter_transport.beta: beta'=beta>0; no fitted or post-hoc beta rescaling is allowed.
parameter_transport.cell_couplings: All scalar couplings and the displayed PAH-001 edge, plaquette, onsite, and aperture terms are inherited without counterterm, zeroing, or scalar repair.
parameter_transport.weights: No cell-dependent weight is inserted at this version; introducing one requires PAH-OMC-003 or a later separately hashed successor.

coarse_map_and_kernel.configuration_map: p_Omega:Omega_(rho',Q)->Omega_(rho,Q) forgets fine-only coordinates while preserving retained integer coordinates, carried orientations, anchors, and fixed Q.
coarse_map_and_kernel.observable_lift: (I_p f)(y)=f(p_Omega(y)) for y in Omega_(rho',Q). This is the cylinder lift used by the strong mainline test; the R-480/R-481 natural-pullback obstruction therefore remains relevant.
coarse_map_and_kernel.fibre_partition: Z_fib(x)=sum_(y:p_Omega(y)=x) exp[-beta F_(rho')(y)] for each coarse x; finite positivity makes Z_fib(x)>0.
coarse_map_and_kernel.conditional_expectation: (E_kappa g)(x)=sum_y kappa(y|x)g(y) for g on Omega_(rho',Q).
coarse_map_and_kernel.normalization_targets: E_kappa 1=1 and E_kappa I_p=id on every finite coarse function.
coarse_map_and_kernel.symmetry_target: For every allowed gauge or anchor automorphism pair (h',h) with p_Omega h'=h p_Omega, require kappa(h'y|hx)=kappa(y|x) and E_kappa U_(h')=U_h E_kappa.
coarse_map_and_kernel.retained_root_transport: For every coarse root r, choose a labelled fine retained-root set R'_r such that p_Omega(r'.y)=r.p_Omega(y) on every admissible pair and inverse labels are preserved.
coarse_map_and_kernel.hidden_root_rule: Fine roots with p_Omega(r'.y)=p_Omega(y) are retained only in L_(rho'); their action is tested as hidden leakage under E_kappa and is not silently deleted from the fine generator.
coarse_map_and_kernel.root_measure: Both sides use the exact PAH-OMC-001 directed-root measures, including invalid, parallel-edge, K=2, and duplicate-channel conventions; no new multiplicity convention is introduced here.

compatibility_targets.strong_mainline: L_(rho') I_p = I_p L_rho on the declared gauge- and anchor-automorphism-invariant cylinder core A_cyl^inv. This is the required Stage-2 target; the named natural pullback has a route-local exact failure already recorded by R-480/R-481.
compatibility_targets.conditional_projected: E_kappa L_(rho') I_p = L_rho on A_rho^inv. This is a weaker diagnostic target and cannot by itself promote the mainline to a uniform limit.
compatibility_targets.defect: If either equality fails, define d_(rho,rho')(f)=L_(rho')I_p f-I_p L_rho f and report a preregistered normalized norm before any parameter fitting.
compatibility_targets.uniform_target: For a future named refinement family, require one common cylinder core and sup_(rho,rho') ||d_(rho,rho')||_infinity -> 0 in the declared order, uniformly over regulator, volume, shape, source, phase, and exhaustion.

finite_acceptance_conditions: The parent and finite-completion hashes match exactly.
p_Omega is a well-defined finite fixed-Q map and every fibre partition Z_fib is positive.
kappa is normalized, nonnegative, and equivariant under the paired gauge/anchor actions.
The retained-root transport is inverse-closed and preserves the PAH-OMC-001 directed multiplicity.
The strong equality is checked on the full declared invariant cylinder core; a projected equality is reported separately rather than substituted.
Any failure records its exact first defect, scope, evidence tier, and one next morphism question.
No finite PASS is promoted to a uniform limit, physical sector, QFT, gravity, Yang--Mills, or observable law.

known_boundaries.natural_pullback: R-480/R-481 show that the source-minimal free-vertex forgetful lift has a nonzero hidden-fibre aperture-rate defect under positive kappa_s and positive scalar beta/kappa_s transport.
known_boundaries.conditional_kernel_role: The conditional kernel changes the coarse averaging diagnostic E_kappa but does not change the strong lift I_p. It therefore cannot erase the already known strong natural-pullback defect; projected compatibility is a separate, unproved proposition.
known_boundaries.successor_boundary: A cell-weight, counterterm, altered functional, altered move set, or non-identity parameter transport is outside PAH-OMC-002 and requires a later separately versioned successor.

missing_evidence: An exact finite audit of conditional-kernel equivariance and projected generator equality for the displayed PAH functional.
A compatible retained-root embedding for an actual subdivision family, not merely one isolated map.
A common invariant cylinder core and a normalized defect norm for every refinement level.
Uniform regulator, volume, shape, source, phase, and exhaustion estimates in the inherited ordered-limit sequence.
An independent formal proof of any accepted projected or strong intertwining identity.
falsifiers: Any fibre has zero partition mass or the conditional kernel is not normalized.
A paired gauge or anchor automorphism changes the kernel or fibre map.
A retained root lacks an inverse, changes fixed Q, or changes directed multiplicity.
The conditional projected equality fails on an exact finite invariant cylinder witness.
A claimed uniform defect bound depends on beta, phase, source, shape, or volume after the holdout is fixed.
Any proof treats E_kappa L'I_p=L as equivalent to the required strong equality without an explicit promotion rule.
non_claims: PAH-OMC-002 is a researcher-proposed hypothesis and is not an external source or physical authority.
No PAH-001 or PAH-OMC-001 bytes, functional, move family, projection, regulator, or limit order are changed.
No exact or uniform refinement theorem is admitted by this contract alone.
The conditional projected target is not a quantum real-time, proper-time, Lorentzian, gravity, QFT, or Yang--Mills construction.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, event-horizon, continuum, mass-gap, cosmic-origin, or TOE conclusion follows.
The R-480/R-481 route-local negative is not a global no-go for other separately versioned morphisms.
single_next_proof_question: For the exact PAH-OMC-002 conditional Gibbs kernel on one finite anchor-preserving subdivision, does E_kappa L_(rho') I_p equal L_rho on the invariant cylinder core, and if not what is the first normalized defect witness?
revisit_condition: Only after the finite conditional-kernel audit passes primary, independent, hostile, and formal checks may a named refinement family and uniform defect test be opened.
stop_or_redesign: Do not count the conditional projected equality as strong generator intertwining.
Do not edit PAH-001 or PAH-OMC-001 to force the kernel target.
If the projected target fails, record the exact witness and keep Stage 2 HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE.
If new weights, counterterms, or dynamics are needed, create PAH-OMC-003 or another separately hashed successor and restart finite auditing.
